summary: A Framer-built page for Pangram Pangram's geometric sans that sells Frama as an industrial product. It moves through mid-century architecture photos, halftone pipes and blades scrubbed frame by frame on scroll, a grey-and-blue 'technical sheet' chapter with a nutrition-label weight list, packaging and case mockups, and an orange four-box tester full of roller-bearing copy. An orange 'PP foundry' logo and a 'GET THE FONT' button stay fixed throughout.

instances.look: A full-bleed photo of a white cantilevered modernist house with oval cut-outs above rocks and lawn; a blue box holds a hairline 'frama' wordmark at left, and two orange info cards ('Celebrating Geometry', 'Beneath Its Apparent Simplicity Lies a Careful Play of Proportion') float over the picture
instances.ux: The photo is cut into depth layers (house, trees, rocks, lawn) that move at different speeds as you scroll, and the cards slide over them; the fixed orange 'PP foundry' logo and 'GET THE FONT' button sit at the corners
instances.learn: Pick a building whose geometry rhymes with the letterforms (ovals, slabs) and set the name in the thinnest weight: the photo argues 'geometric' before any copy
